versions.content: When a call to Com_SendSignal or Com_SendSignalGroup results into a change of the transmission mode of a started I-PDU to the transmission mode PERIODIC or MIXED, then the AUTOSAR COM module shall start the new transmission cycle with a call to PduR_ComTransmit within the next main function at the latest. The transmission shall be initiated regardless of the transfer property of the signal or signal group that caused the transmission mode switch. The minimum delay time shall still be respected. See also Figure 5 The AUTOSAR COM module’s interaction model for reception.
